Best restaurant in Hanoi!
Apr 2017 • Couples
I've been to lots of restaurants in my (almost) three years of staying in Hanoi an The Attic is above all others I've come to when it comes to a great meal with just the right atmosphere. Staff is extremely friendly, meals are always excellent without fail. If I had to make any complaint... There was one time my steak was under cooked but was immediately taken care of without issue and that was only once of all the time I've been a patron of this fine establishment. The Attic is an absolute must for anyone traveling to Hanoi!

cosy place with value feast
Oct 2016 • Friends
nice atmosphere, good background music. i love the natural light and light setting, makes you feel hungry and the food more tasty :)) ideal for friends, couples, or small group meetings. staff is friendly and keen though lack of attentiveness.

i had a lamb steak, really good choice. you should try their grilled potatoes! awesome! i did not expect it to be that delicious and haunting. the pasta is homemade and fresh and over the moon. bad point is that there are too much pasta and sauce and meat, though all served with a really reasonable price. i worried for the owner and I even said so to the manager lol. but it's their style of doing business: fill your stomach and empty their pocket =)) I'll definitely come back for this reason!
